decisions.reason: Still listed on the website after two years and close to the established offer, it appears to meet aspirations, so the firm is likely to keep it.
Although its web presence was reduced from a dedicated page to a mention, it is still promoted and benefits from slack, making a drop less likely.
As a recently launched 2024 product with its own page and no sign of shortfall, the firm's slack supports keeping it while results remain uncertain.
